independent_treatments: The A page uses two independent full treatments as context: Silver–Williams (research paper) and Hatcher (complete textbook). Hatcher supplies covering and cellular-homology interfaces; Silver–Williams supplies a separate Alexander-module chain treatment with different relative/presentation conventions. Cochran’s full lecture corroborates the absolute-module convention. No source is treated as a substitute for the local proof.
